purpose: GD10 source reference for adapting an existing OpenYOLO3D checkout; not a standalone executable distribution
adaptation_required: Create a platform-local entry with dataset root, processed root, output root and scene-list arguments.
Do not execute the heldout wrapper unchanged: its closure_assets import, LOCAL/OUT/TRAIN_FRONT, inventory, selection and auditor refer to this host and are intentionally not bundled.
Use Frontends(grounded_sam), export_frame, assemble_arm and track_arm from the unchanged core. Explicitly set manifest arms D to list(range(0, original_frame_count, 10)); core D defaults to stride5.
Preserve original frame IDs, exact point order, receipts and hash validation; create a new output directory.
Audit the adapted entry and run one-scene verification before the complete312. Do not tune on validation312.
input_requirements: Original RGB/depth/poses with original numeric frame IDs; 30-frame caches alone are insufficient.
Scene mesh, intrinsics.txt, processed point/superpoint numpy with identical mesh point order.
Current build_scene_manifest inventories uniform30 plus stride5 before D is overridden; keep the full original input sequence available.
downstream: Outputs are geometry frontend assets, not final instance AP. New geometry requires matching D-v3 inference, own-geometry YOLO/Alpha evidence and scorer application. GD text labels are provenance, not final semantic binding.
